title: AYE WAARIS E SHABBIR AB AAJAO QUDARA
body:
AYE WAARIS E SHABBIR AB AAJAO QUDARA.
1.Aye Waaris E Shabbir Ab Aajao Qudara.
Aye Sahibe Tatheer Ghareebon Ka Sahara.
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Ek Aapse Ummeed Hai Aye Hujjate Aaqer.
Ho Jaayiey Ho Jaayiey Ab Daher May Zahir.
Pursaan E Haal Koun Hai Duniya May Humara....
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Har Samt Se Hai Zulm Ki Yalgaar Musalsal.
Har Ek Se Imaa Ko Hai Aazaar Musalal.
Dushwaar Huwa Jaata Hai Momin Ka Guzara.....
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Jis Khoon May Hai Ishq E Ali Or Gham E Sarwar.
Paani Ki Tarah Usko Bahate Hai Sitamgar.
Kya Aapko Iss Khoon Ka Behna Hai Gawara....
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Islam Jo Hai Aapki Ajdaad Ki Mehnat. Phir Narghaye Aada Mayahai Bay Aas Ki Surat.
Duniya May Wohi Deen Hai Taqdeer Ka Maara....
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Hum Bichaye Huway Raahon May Pade Hain.
Hum Sar Pe Kafan Baandh Ke Taiiyar Khade Hain.
Ek Aapki Janib Se Bhi Hojayae Ishaara.....
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Aawaaz Lagati Hai Tumhe Karbobala Phir.
Kounain Me Goonje Wohi Halmin Ki Sada Phir.
Chamkega Yahi Deen Ki Kismat Ka ....
Aye Waarise Shabbir Ab Aajao Qudara..
AZZ:-Ali Anjum Sadiq
